name: Yokogawa Bridge Holdings Corp.
summary: Yokogawa Bridge Holdings Corp. engages in the design, fabrication, and construction of steel structures in Japan and internationally. It operates through five segments: Bridge Business, System Building Business, Engineering Business, Advanced Technology Business, and Other Businesses. The company designs, fabricates, and erects steel bridge projects; and maintains, repairs, and retrofits existing structures.
